changes: Sunday columns January–June 2020 from the archived global cumulative confirmed-case table, retrieved 2026-10-26. Original source counts and administrative reference coordinates preserved. Rows without coordinates or at (0,0) excluded. No daily increments, interpolation or case locations inferred. Reporting/testing definitions differ by place and time. Weekly snapshots are cumulative totals, not new cases; dates are UTC display anchors, not diagnosis instants. No tracks.
